answers.architectDesignChange: Spec decision 'a full stream refuses new messages': streamCfg uses DiscardNew; start and keeper set it; bus.ErrStreamFull (not ErrRefused) wraps the server's 'maximum bytes exceeded' (10077); the webhook answers 503 (TestA...FullStream test in internal/webhook); #2228's notice rewording reverted (envoy-client, pi-envoy, claude-envoy are now unchanged from c78a4e925318; #2228's implementer told); the redelivery sweep is left to INFRA-493 per the architect, and packages/envoy/AGENTS.md says so.

proof.criterion: Copies, the byte limit and envoy_stream_id end right after two programs with different settings start at the same moment (mixed-settings race), every round
proof.surface: Real envoy-listener and envoy-dispatch binaries against three nats-server v2.15.1 processes clustered on loopback with the rendered grants (the tester's harness)
proof.observed: 8/8 pairs PASS: replicas 3 on 3 current peers, max_bytes 2000000, discard new, an id, buckets 3 3 3, both programs alive; the race lowered the stream in 6 pairs and the keeper logged restored="replicas 1 -> 3, max_bytes -1 -> 2000000" each time.
proof.negativeControl: The same harness at 0681b1218da2 (no keeper) ended 7 of 8 pairs at {"replicas":1,"max_bytes":-1} (tester, https://github.com/sjawhar/legion/pull/2362#issuecomment-6434935100)

proof.criterion: A stream update from the listener and Dispatch keeps three copies, the byte limit, DiscardNew and envoy_stream_id; R1 stream and bucket raised to three; a full stream refuses a publish and keeps every stored message
proof.surface: Real envoy-listener and envoy-dispatch binaries (Postgres 17 on the issue volume) against three nats-server v2.15.1 processes and one standalone v2.15.1 server, read with natscli v0.5.1
proof.observed: P1: R1 stream and KV_envoy_interests raised to 3 current peers, max_bytes 44023414784, discard new, one id over two reads, messages kept, durable at 3. P2: restart at setting 1 with no limit changed nothing. P3: envoy-dispatch put back 3 dropped subjects (5 -> 8) keeping copies, limit, discard and id. P4: a stream at ENVOY_STREAM_MAX_BYTES=3000 acknowledged 10 of 30 JetStream publishes and refused 20 with 'nats: error: maximum bytes exceeded (10077)'; it kept messages 1-10, full-1 first.
proof.negativeControl: Standalone v2.15.1: ENVOY_NATS_REPLICAS=3 -> exit 1 'ENVOY_NATS_REPLICAS=3: nats: replicas > 1 not supported in non-clustered mode'; ENVOY_STREAM_MAX_BYTES=44023414784 on its 29 GB store -> exit 1 '...: insufficient storage resources available'; ENVOY_NATS_REPLICAS=0 -> 'invalid ENVOY_NATS_REPLICAS "0": want a whole number of copies from 1 to 5'

trickyParts: The keeper's subjects are add-only; a read still holding a role lane makes it send nothing, since only a start moves role lanes (after the consumer filters).
A full-stream publish error is nats APIError code 10077 'maximum bytes exceeded'; bus.ErrStreamFull wraps it and is not ErrRefused, so the webhook answers 503 and the send routes 500.
